title: acmella biflora
intro: Acmella biflora, commonly known as parlor spice or toothache plant, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family. The plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving pain, particularly toothache. The therapeutic actions of Acmella biflora are attributed to its ability to inhibit the production of prostaglandins, which contribute to pain and inflammation. Bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, particularly spilanthol and flavonoids, are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
